add_options.name: BTCC 1991
add_options.summary: Points to the top ten of each race (24-18-12-10-8-6-4-3-2-1).
add_options.description: Each race pays points to the top ten. At the two meetings with two races, each race paid half points to the top eight. No dropped scores.

add_options.name: Super Touring 1991
add_options.summary: Two-litre production saloons with about 270 hp.
add_options.description: The first Super Touring cars. They are slower than Group A cars on the straights. Calibrate against 1991 BTCC qualifying times.

add_options.name: Super Touring 1991
add_options.summary: 950 kg for front-wheel drive cars, 1050 kg for rear-wheel drive cars.
add_options.description: The limit depends on the drive layout. Team car masses carry the higher weight of the BMW M3 and the Ford Sierra.
